name: FlowDrop AI Context
description: A FlowDrop node processor that injects AI Context into workflows.
project_description:
FlowDrop AI Context module provides integration between Context Control Center (CCC) module and FlowDrop , adding FlowDrop node processors for enabling structured and reusable AI context inside the FlowDrop workflow editor.

 It acts as a bridge between workflow orchestration and contextual AI data management, making it easier to build advanced AI-driven Drupal applications.

 Key Features 
 
 Plug-and-Play AI Context 
 Drop a context node into any workflow to give your AI agents the background information they need.

 Two Ways to Add Context 
 Pin a specific piece of information when building the workflow, or let the system automatically pick the most relevant context at the moment the workflow runs.

 Smart Auto-Selection 
 The dynamic selector reads the incoming request and chooses the right context for the job, so your AI always gets the most useful information without manual setup.

 Organised Knowledge Hierarchy 
 Group related information together when a main topic is selected, all its supporting details come along automatically, keeping answers complete and consistent.

 Consistent, AI-Friendly Format 
 Every piece of context is delivered in a clean, structured format that AI models understand reliably, producing more predictable and accurate results.

 Reusable Across Workflows 
 Define your context once in a central library and reuse it everywhere. Update it in one place and every workflow stays in sync.

 Agent-Aware Behaviour 
 When connected to an AI agent, the node automatically follows that agent's context rules, ensuring a consistent experience whether context is added manually or selected

 automatically.
 

 
 

 
 Contributing 
 The FlowDrop AI Context (CCC) module's issue queue is intended for reporting bugs, submitting feature requests, and planning. 

 

 Additionally, you can join the #flowdrop channel on Drupal Slack .
